Associate Director, Commerce at wppmedia. London. Apply for this Associate Director, Commerce opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

&lt;div class="content-intro"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About WPP Media&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;For more information, visit &lt;a href="wppmedia.com"&gt;wppmedia.com&lt;/a&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;3138 - Associate Director, Commerce -UK&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Role Summary and Impact&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;OpenMind by WPP is an integrated agency model drawing on talent from across WPP. It has been created to accelerate the European transformation for Nestlé’s media function. Core to the solution is the advanced best data and technology capabilities, fuelled by WPP’s investment in AI, to maximise the impact of Nestlé media investment. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;As an eCommerce Account Director, you will be responsible for the coordination and delivery of your client accounts across platforms whilst operating as the main campaign activation point of contact for our clients.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Utilising platform expertise and account management practices, you’ll ensure effective management of projects to brief, schedule and budget. Ultimately, you’ll work to deliver industry-leading eCommerce campaigns which exceed our clients’ expectations.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;The role will involve line management of more junior members of the team, overseeing their work and development to successfully deliver to client expectations.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;We are looking to continue our exceptional growth, seeking an eCommerce Account Director to come and join the growing community in OpenMind eCommerce Practice. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Skills and Experience&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;Be &lt;strong&gt;Extraordinary&lt;/strong&gt; by &lt;em&gt;Leading Collectively&lt;/em&gt; to &lt;em&gt;Inspire transformational Creativity.&lt;/em&gt;&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Create an &lt;strong&gt;Open&lt;/strong&gt; environment by&lt;em&gt; Balancing People and Client Experiences&lt;/em&gt; by &lt;em&gt;Cultivating Trust&lt;/em&gt;.&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Lead &lt;strong&gt;Optimistically&lt;/strong&gt; by &lt;em&gt;Championing Growth&lt;/em&gt; &lt;em&gt;and Development&lt;/em&gt; to &lt;em&gt;Mobilize the Enterprise&lt;/em&gt;.&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt; &lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About You:&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;You are an established senior member within an eCommerce environment and a known experienced specialist in Retail and Commerce Media. You demonstrate to be proactive and inquisitive, and a real driver who inspires direct reports and peers alike. You are confidently challenging inherited ways of working with your own ideas for improvement and evolution that fit the overarching OpenMind processes and vision.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Key skills&lt;/p&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;In-depth understanding of eCommerce campaign set-up, management, optimisation and reporting across media owner and technology vendor platforms&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Excellent understanding of the strategic and tactical application of eCommerce and digital marketing in general&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Proven project management, leadership and people management experience.&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Life at WPP Media & Benefits&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;Please read our Privacy Notice (&lt;a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy"&gt;&lt;strong&gt;https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/a&gt; for more information on how we process the information you provide.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt; &lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;#LI-Promoted&lt;/p&gt;&lt;div class="content-conclusion"&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt; &lt;p&gt;&lt;span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"&gt;&lt;span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8"&gt;Please read our &lt;a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment"&gt;Privacy Notice&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"&gt; &lt;span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8"&gt;for more information on how we process the information you provide.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"&gt; &lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt; Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
